g.text: Omitted supporting tables: OTP/invitations, train days/class enum collections, cancelled runs, user notifications, booking outbox, webhook and delivery logs.

g.text: Service ownership is preserved. Invariants such as a published route having at least two stops are validated in services, not guaranteed by every FK.

g.text: Source: entity mappings across the eight persistence services. Foreign-key annotations and scalar references are deliberately distinguished.
